newsitem.title: CHINA: Huangshan Tourism approve plan to issue A shares.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan Tourism approve plan to issue A shares.

text.p: A shareholders meeting of Huangshan Tourism has approved a plan to issue 50 million domestic A shares, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The statement said the meeting on Tuesday approved the plan to list the shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The timing and price of the offer have yet to be decided.
After the issue, the company will have total of 243 million outstanding shares, consisting of 113 million state shares, 80 million B shares and 50 million A shares, it said.
